verdict.rationale: Bland is a voice AI phone-agent platform, so noise suppression and audio filtering are fair questions to ask of it. None of the evidence documents a noise-cancellation, background-noise filtering or audio-filtering setting. The closest items, browser microphone use and voice cloning sample quality, are adjacent features and do not address call-audio noise handling.

support.subject: As a developer, I can enable noise suppression or audio filtering so the agent stays coherent on noisy real-world calls
